In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebels]] led by [[Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa]] in order to meet with [[Sagwa]], a contact of [[Chewbacca]], who had information regarding a sighting of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] on the moon.<ref name="Star Wars 13" /> At the same [[time]], [[bounty]] [[hunter]]s [[Beilert Valance]] and [[Dengar]] also arrived in search of Fett.<ref name="Bounty Hunters 13" />
